title: Website
description: Design company pages, layouts, headers, footers, presets, data sets, and themes, then publish a live site.
needCompany: Select a company account in WebOnOne to design a website. Pages are scoped to your active company.
pagesDescription: The site map. Create pages, open the designer, or browse the live page.
headersDescription: Headers use the same designer as pages. Layouts pick which header wraps a page.
footersDescription: Footers use the same designer as pages. Layouts pick which footer wraps a page.
presetsDescription: Reusable block layouts. Design once, then insert them from the add-on dialog.
datasetsDescription: Named live queries over company catalog, staff, users, and analytics. Only data exposed here can appear on the public website.
themesDescription: Theme tokens for fonts, colors, text styles, and buttons.
layoutsDescription: Named shells that pair a header, footer, and theme. Assign pages so Home and About can share one layout while Help uses another.
mediaDescription: Company media library. Image add-ons pick files from here.
mediaLibraryDescription: Shared website library. Images added here can be used on library pages, headers, and footers. A company that uses that item sees the images from their public URL.
settingsDescription: Site-wide options such as which page visitors see at your root URL.
homePageSettingsDescription: Choose which active page loads when someone opens your site URL without a path.
homePageHint: When set, visitors who open your site root URL see this page. Otherwise the page with an empty path is used.
addFromLibraryDescription: Choose a shared item. A copy is added to your website. You can edit that copy, and Revert to default replaces it with the current library item.
addedFromLibrary: Added a copy to your website
addFromLibraryFailed: Could not add from the library
addSourceLibraryHint: Copy a shared {{noun}} into this website. Later edits stay on your copy.
addSourceCreateHint: Create a new {{noun}} for this website. It is not copied from the library.
emptyPages: No pages yet. Create one to start designing.
emptyPresets: No presets yet. Create one to reuse blocks in the designer.
emptyPresetsPicker: No presets yet. Create one under Website → Presets.
emptyDatasets: No data sets yet. Create one to expose live company data to the website.
emptyLayouts: No layouts yet. Create one to assign headers and footers to pages.
revertToLibraryDescription: Your edits on this copy are replaced with the current library item. The name stays. The shared library is not changed.
revertLayoutDescription: This layout is pointed back at the library header, footer, and theme, and those copies are replaced with the current library versions. The layout name stays. The shared library is not changed.
revertToLibraryFailed: Could not revert to the library version
downloadUpdatedFromLibraryTitle: Download the latest {{name}} from the library?
downloadUpdatedFromLibraryDescription: This copy is replaced with the current library item. Your edits on this copy are lost. The shared library is not changed.
downloadUpdatedFromLibraryFailed: Could not download the library update
createPageDescription: Give the page a name and URL path, then open the designer.
createHeaderDescription: Create a header layout used at the top of the published site.
createFooterDescription: Create a footer layout used at the bottom of the published site.
saveAsPresetDescription: Name this block to reuse it from the add-on dialog.
saveAsPresetDisabled: Already editing a preset. Use Save to update it.
createPresetDescription: Name the preset, then open the designer to lay out blocks and add-ons.
editPresetDescription: Rename this preset. Open the designer to change its layout.
createDatasetDescription: Choose a data source and filters. The website will show live matching rows — not a snapshot.
datasetNoRules: No filters yet — every matching row for this source is included.
datasetNoFields: No filter fields for this source.
datasetPropertiesHelp: Choose which item fields this data set exposes for preview, the public site, and content binding.
datasetPreviewAfterSave: Save the data set first to preview live results. Filters are stored and applied on the next load.
datasetPreviewEmpty: No matching items for this data set yet.
createThemeDescription: Name the theme. Basic settings, fonts, colors, texts, and buttons are edited on the theme page.
createLayoutDescription: Name a shell, pick a header, footer, and theme, then assign pages to it.
editLayoutDescription: Change the header, footer, theme, and the order of pages in this layout’s menu.
deleteLayoutDescription: Pages must use another layout before you can delete this one.
deleteThemeDescription: Layouts must use another theme before you can delete this one.
menuOrderHint: Active pages on this layout appear in the header nav menu in this order.
createFontDescription: Add a font from the library, or enter a custom Google Font. The name, URL, and font family are saved on this theme.
addFontLibraryHint: Use a shared font. The name, URL, and font family are saved on this theme.
addFontCustomHint: Enter a Google Font URL. The name and font family are saved on this theme.
addGoogleFontGuide: Add a font from the library, or enter a custom Google Font URL. Then assign the font on the Texts tab.
createColorDescription: Add a color from the library, or create your own. The name and value are saved on this theme.
addColorLibraryHint: Use a shared color. The name and value are saved on this theme.
addColorCustomHint: Pick a color and name it. The color is saved on this theme only.
editColorNameHint: You can rename this color. The color value stays as it was copied from the library.
pickColorHint: Select a color. The name and value are copied onto this theme.
pickColorRequired: Select a color from the library.
colorAlreadyOnTheme: This color is already on the theme.
createTextStyleDescription: Choose a font, sizes, and color for this text style.
editTextStyleDescription: Typography, HTML, styles, and script for this theme text.
createButtonStyleDescription: Choose a font, colors, and shape for this button.
editButtonStyleDescription: Colors, typography, HTML, styles, and script for this theme button.
name: Name
pathHint: Leave empty for the home page. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and slashes.

designerAssistant.title: Design assistant
designerAssistant.hint: Ask to add a heading, button, image, menu, or slider on this canvas. Copy an item from the content tree to name that element. Confirm to place it, then Save.
designerAssistant.placeholder: Describe what to add or change…
designerAssistant.name: Assistant
designerAssistant.failed: The assistant is unavailable right now.
designerAssistant.setupRequired: Connect an AI provider in Settings before chatting.
designerAssistant.applied: Updated the canvas. Save to keep it.
designerAssistant.nothingApplied: Could not match those elements on the canvas.

addAddonDescription: Choose an add-on or a saved preset to place inside the selected block.
containerHeightHint: Height for the size selected in the designer. Dragging the strip under the canvas changes only that size.
containerSettingsDescription: Set height and background for the whole page, header, or footer design area.
blockSettingsDescription: Configure appearance and options for this block.
groupNameHint: Same name marks the same type of block. Used when a parent loops dataset rows.
dataBindingBlockHelp: Bind a dataset and choose which child group to repeat for each row. Insert a preset as a child, then select its group here.
dataBindingSliderHelp: Choose how this slider gets its slides. Bind a dataset so each row becomes one slide, or enter slides manually. Build the slide layout with + (presets or content blocks). Set Item group to the child group name that is the repeating card. Map fields on nested add-ons inside that card.
itemGroupHint: Repeats the first direct child with this group name once per dataset item.
sliderItemGroupHint: Which block under the slider (by group name) is the card for each data row. Add a preset so it appears in this list.
inheritedBindingFromSliderHelp: This block sits inside a slider that already provides dataset "{{dataset}}". Each slide row is passed down automatically.
inheritedBindingItemGroupHelp: This is the slider item group "{{group}}". Dataset "{{dataset}}" is bound on the parent slider — you do not need to select a dataset here.
inheritedBindingSkipDataset: Skip picking a dataset here. Choose which property from each parent row this element should receive.
parentPropertyHint: Object properties scope nested field maps. Array properties feed nested sliders or repeating child groups.
dataBindingSliderInheritedHelp: This slider sits under a parent dataset row. Choose which array/object property supplies its slides — you do not pick a new dataset.
addonDataBindingInheritedHelp: Rows come from the parent slider dataset "{{dataset}}". Map this add-on's props to fields — you do not need to pick a dataset again.
addonDataBindingNestedRowHelp: This add-on sits inside a nested slider fed by "{{path}}" on dataset "{{dataset}}". Map props to fields on each {{path}} item (for example URL), not the outer product row.
addonDataBindingNeedsParent: Bind a dataset on a parent block first.
addonDataBindingUnsupported: This add-on type does not support data binding yet.
addonDataBindingHelp: Map fields from dataset “{{dataset}}” onto this add-on.
advancedSettingPlaceholder: Advanced options will be available here.
noBlocks: Add a block to start laying out this {{kind}}.
unsavedDescription: Leave the designer without saving? Your changes will be lost.
menuDescription: Custom menu with sub-items, theme text styles, and per-breakpoint layout (inline, hamburger, wrap, or scroll).
menuBreakpointHint: Display settings apply to the current breakpoint. Other sizes inherit unless overridden.
menuItemsEmpty: No menu items yet. Add one to get started.
imageDescription: Photo or graphic from the company media library, with an optional image per breakpoint.
sliderDescription: Carousel of slide children (add-ons, presets, or content blocks), filled from a data set or manual slide values.
sliderEmptyTemplate: Use + on the slider to add add-ons, presets, or content blocks as slide children.
sliderEmptySlides: Add manual slides or bind a data set with rows to show in this slider.
sliderPresetHint: The preset is copied into this slider as the repeating slide layout.
sliderDatasetHint: Each data set row becomes one slide from the child layout. Items that fit in the slider width are visible; use next/previous to slide.
sliderNoBindableFields: Map fields on nested add-ons inside the slide (Data Binding) to edit values here.
sliderPickPresetFirst: Add slide children with + before editing manual slide fields.
textDescription: Paragraph or heading that uses a theme text style.
buttonDescription: Themed button that can link to another page on this site.
cropDescription: Drag to reposition. Use zoom and aspect ratio controls to adjust the crop area.
autoSlideHint: Automatically advance slides in the designer and on the published page
itemsPerSlideHint: How many cards show at once; arrows and dots move by the same count
sliderBreakpointHint: Basic settings apply to the current canvas size. Smaller sizes inherit from the nearest larger size unless overridden.
label: Label
themeColorPaletteEmptyHint: Add a color palette on the Color palettes tab, then pick these colors from that palette.
elementPreviewHint: Live preview uses general settings plus any HTML, styles, and scripts you add.
elementLivePreviewHint: Updates as you change basic settings, HTML, styles, or scripts.
elementGeneralCardDescription: Name, typography, colors, and shape for this button.
elementHtmlCurrentHint: Complete current markup. The root must be the <button>. Basic settings apply to that button as CSS variables. Extra Tailwind classes on the same button override those values.
themeTokenMissing: This style is no longer on the theme.
elementHtmlPlaceholderButton: The root element must be a <button>. Basic settings apply to that button as CSS variables; add Tailwind classes on the same button to override them. Use {{label}} for the caption.
elementHtmlPlaceholderText: Inner HTML for the text. Use {{content}} for the text body.
elementHtmlPlaceholderBlock: HTML for this block only. Keep {{children}} where nested blocks and add-ons render. Do not paste their markup here.
elementHtmlBlockHint: This markup is the block shell only. Nested blocks and add-ons are not included. Keep {{children}}.
elementStylesHint: CSS for this element. Keep the .website-el-… root class and add properties inside it. Scripts can use the same class or root.querySelector.
elementScriptsHint: JavaScript runs in the live preview when the element mounts. Use root (the element) or document.querySelector('.website-el-…'). Palette colors are CSS variables --el-color-1 through --el-color-6. .animate-slide-up is available. Timers reset when the preview remounts.
paletteHint: Use 1 to 7 colors. You can rename them later on the Colors tab.
importPaletteCallout: On CColorPalette, choose a palette of 1–7 colors → Export → CSS variables, then paste the :root { … } block to fill the palette.
importPaletteDescription: Paste the :root { … } block from CColorPalette (Export → CSS variables).
importPaletteInvalid: Paste a valid :root block with --color-1 through --color-7, or semantic --color-primary through --color-text.
emptyFonts: No fonts yet. Add one from the library or enter a custom Google Font to use in text styles.
pickFontHint: Select a font. The name, Google Font URL, and font family are copied onto this theme.
fontLibrarySuperAdminMessage: These fonts are shared with every company website. A custom font you add is saved to this library.
customFontLibraryNote: This custom font is also saved to the shared library.
fontLibrarySaveFailed: Could not save the font to the library.
fontLibraryEmptySuperAdmin: The font library is empty. Add a custom font to create one here.
pickFontRequired: Select a font from the library.
fontAlreadyOnTheme: This font is already on the theme.
fontLibraryLoadFailed: Could not load the font library.
fontLibraryPageDescription: Shared Google Fonts available to every company when they add fonts to a theme.
fontLibrarySuperAdminOnly: Only Super Admin can manage the shared font library.
addFontToLibraryDescription: Paste a Google Font stylesheet URL. The font is shared with all company websites.
fontLibraryDeleteFailed: Could not remove the font from the library.

editFontNameHint: You can rename this font. The Google Font URL and font family stay as they were copied from the library.

customColorLibraryNote: This custom color is also saved to the shared library.
colorLibrarySaveFailed: Could not save the color to the library.
colorLibraryEmptySuperAdmin: The color library is empty. Add a color to create one here.
colorLibraryLoadFailed: Could not load the color library.
colorLibraryApplyFailed: Could not apply the color palette to this theme.
colorLibraryPageDescription: Shared color palettes (up to six named colors each) that companies can apply to a theme.
paletteColorsSectionDescription: Named colors companies can pick when styling themes.
paletteColorsListDescription: Named colors in this palette. Edit to add, remove, or change colors.
addColorPaletteToLibraryDescription: Name the palette and add up to six colors, each with a name and hex value. Companies apply the full set to their theme.
addColorPaletteLibraryHint: Apply a shared palette to this theme.
emptyThemeColorPalettes: No color palettes yet. Add a palette from the library to use its colors in this theme.
themeColorPaletteDetailDescription: Review and edit this palette on the theme. Changes apply to text and button styles that use these colors.
editThemePaletteOverviewDescription: Update the palette name shown on this theme.
editThemePaletteColorsDescription: Change color names and values for this palette on the theme.
pickColorPaletteHint: Select a palette. All colors in the palette are copied onto this theme.
pickColorPaletteRequired: Select a color palette from the library.
colorPaletteAlreadyOnTheme: This palette is already on the theme.
editFontLibraryDescription: Update the shared font name and Google Font URL.
editColorPaletteLibraryDescription: Update the palette name and its named colors.
colorLibraryUpdated: Color palette updated in the library.
colorLibrarySuperAdminOnly: Only Super Admin can manage the shared color library.
addColorToLibraryDescription: Name the color and pick a value. It is shared with all company websites.
colorLibraryDeleteFailed: Could not remove the color from the library.
deleteColorLibraryDescription: “{{name}}” will no longer appear when companies pick colors from the library. Themes that already use it are not changed.
textLibraryPageDescription: Shared text styles available when companies add typography to a theme.
textLibrarySuperAdminOnly: Only Super Admin can manage the shared text library.
addTextToLibraryDescription: Pick a font and color from the shared libraries and set a base size.
editTextLibraryDescription: Update the name, font, color, and size for this shared text style.
textLibraryUpdated: Text style updated in the library.
textLibraryAdded: Text style added to the library.
textLibraryDeleted: Text style removed from the library.

textLibrarySaveFailed: Could not save the text style to the library.

textLibraryEmptySuperAdmin: No shared text styles yet. Add one for companies to reuse on themes.
textLibraryLoadFailed: Could not load the text library.
pickFontAndColorRequired: Select a font and color from the shared libraries.
addTextLibraryHint: Reuse a shared text style. Fonts and colors are added to the theme as needed.
addTextCustomHint: Build a text style from fonts and colors already on this theme.
pickTextStyleRequired: Select a text style from the library.
pickTextStyleHint: Select a text style. Matching fonts and colors are copied onto this theme.
buttonLibraryPageDescription: Shared button styles available when companies add buttons to a theme.
buttonLibrarySuperAdminOnly: Only Super Admin can manage the shared button library.
addButtonToLibraryDescription: Define colors, typography, and shape. Companies can add this style to their themes.
editButtonLibraryDescription: Update colors, typography, and shape for this shared button style.
buttonLibraryUpdated: Button style updated in the library.
buttonLibraryAdded: Button style added to the library.
buttonLibraryDeleted: Button style removed from the library.
buttonLibraryDeleteFailed: Could not remove the button style from the library.
buttonLibrarySaveFailed: Could not save the button style to the library.
deleteButtonLibraryDescription: “{{name}}” will no longer appear when companies pick button styles from the library. Themes that already use it are not changed.
buttonLibraryEmptySuperAdmin: No shared button styles yet. Add one for companies to reuse on themes.
buttonLibraryLoadFailed: Could not load the button library.
pickButtonLibraryFieldsRequired: Complete all font and color fields.
addButtonLibraryHint: Reuse a shared button style. Related tokens are added to the theme as needed.
addButtonCustomHint: Build a custom button with the same basic settings as a library button, using fonts and colors already on this theme.
pickButtonStyleRequired: Select a button style from the library.
pickButtonStyleHint: Select a button style. Matching fonts, colors, and label text styles are copied onto this theme.
emptyColors: No colors yet. Import from CColorPalette or add a color to use in text and button styles.
